travel.nri_angle: Ontario's Niagara region has a growing South Asian community, and its Diwali fireworks rules differ sharply by municipality — Niagara Falls and St. Catharines permit them on set dates, while Welland and Thorold do not permit a Diwali display as of right.

travel.title: Ekta Nagar's Glow Garden and 1.5-Crore-Light Display Draw Diwali-Week Families
travel.excerpt: An upgraded Unity Glow Garden, a 530-metre illuminated stretch and a 180-metre Glow Tunnel anchor Ekta Prakash Parv at the Statue of Unity, while Bharat Parv runs until November 15 and the statue stays open on Monday, November 9.
travel.nri_angle: Ekta Nagar's upgraded glow garden and light festival give diaspora families visiting Gujarat for Diwali a concrete after-dark itinerary at the Statue of Unity, including a special Monday opening on November 9.

carousel.title: Teen Chess Master Md Imran Risks US Scholarship as Visa Deadline Closes In
carousel.excerpt: The 17-year-old International Master's approved F-1 visa was in the passport he lost in Bratislava. Four months without a US appointment, he must be stamped by January 19, 2027 — or lose his full UTRGV scholarship.
carousel.image_caption: A composite image shows an Indian passport and chess player Md Imran holding a tournament certificate in Hungary. Imran lost his original passport, and the approved US F-1 visa inside it, in Bratislava in June 2026.
carousel.nri_angle: A young Indian athlete's US study path hangs on F-1 appointment availability — the same bottleneck diaspora families face for student visas every admission cycle.

carousel.title: Kejriwal, Daughter Threatened in Call Demanding Rs 7 Crore in Bishnoi Gang's Name
carousel.excerpt: The threat reached AAP MLA Jarnail Singh, who complained to Mohali Police on November 6. A case is registered, but the caller's claimed gang link is unverified.
carousel.image_caption: Arvind Kejriwal addresses a press conference in front of an Aam Aadmi Party backdrop. Mohali Police have registered a case after a caller claiming Bishnoi gang membership demanded Rs 7 crore and threatened Kejriwal and his daughter.
carousel.nri_angle: Kejriwal leads the AAP, a party with deep support in Punjab and among the Punjabi diaspora; an extortion threat invoking the Bishnoi gang touches a diaspora community that follows Punjab security news closely.

carousel.title: Bollywood Romance 'Weekend' Eyes First Indian Feature Shoot in Russia's Yakutia
carousel.excerpt: Producer Vivek Singhania's Picture Perfect has signed a three-way MoU with Saidam Baryl and Sakhafilm, Yakutia's state-backed studio, to explore shooting the romantic drama in the Sakha Republic — a first for an Indian feature.
carousel.image_caption: Yhyakh is a New Year celebration in Sakha Republic (Yakutia). The Bollywood romantic drama Weekend is eyeing a shoot in Russia's Sakha Republic, known as Yakutia, after producer Vivek Singhania's Picture Perfect signed a memorandum of understanding with local outfits Saidam Baryl and Sakhafilm.
carousel.image_credit: Photo: Tenebroid via Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0)
carousel.nri_angle: An Indian production exploring a first-ever feature shoot in Yakutia extends Bollywood's long, Soviet-era popularity in Russia's far east to a new frontier.

carousel.title: Gemini 4 Carbon Tops AI Benchmark by One Point, but Opus Keeps Coding Lead
carousel.excerpt: Google's new model leads the Artificial Analysis index and hallucinates far less than Opus 5.5 — though more than its own predecessor. Anthropic still wins on coding agents.
carousel.image_caption: Google Gemini artificial intelligence. Gemini 4 Carbon tops an AI benchmark by one point while Claude Opus keeps the coding lead.

carousel.title: India's Retail Inflation Breaches RBI Ceiling at 6.09% as Food Prices Surge
carousel.excerpt: October's CPI reading, the highest since October 2024, crossed the RBI's 6% upper tolerance limit as food inflation hit 8.94% and onion prices more than doubled, strengthening expectations of a second straight rate hike in December.
carousel.image_caption: A trader sorts onions at a wholesale market, with sacks of onions stacked behind him. Onion prices rose 116.22% year on year in October, driving India's food inflation to 8.94%.
carousel.nri_angle: Inflation above the RBI ceiling and a possible December rate hike affect rupee returns on NRE deposits and the cost of supporting family budgets in India.
